coverAudit.conclusion: Reliable for an already established IsCrouching state and actual current collider overlap; does not depend on Trigger callbacks. Does not establish crouching from an input event before Player.Update processes it.
coverAudit.geometry: IsHidden rejects invalid/dead/disabled/transition-blocked/non-crouching players, inspects enabled non-trigger child colliders belonging to this player, and calls ComputePenetration using explicit current Transform positions and rotations against registered active BoxColliders.
coverAudit.lifecycle: OnEnable registers; OnDisable removes; null entries are pruned; subsystem registration clears and after-scene-load repopulates for disabled reload settings.
coverAudit.physicsBoundary: Project m_AutoSyncTransforms is false, but ComputePenetration is a direct pair/pose query. Player Rigidbody uses interpolation; this audit does not claim prediction of a pending physics movement or certify render/physics interpolation edge cases without actual Play tests.
coverAudit.playerTiming: PlayerController.Update:111 samples crouchHeld. Ground state Update transitions to PlayerCrouchState.Enter:8, which sets IsCrouching. PlayerController.FixedUpdate does not consume new crouch input.
